cross_disciplinary_pairing.description: BusinessPilot AI is an offline business copilot for African SMEs combining AI scheduling, financial analysis, CSV data exploration, document Q&A, and bilingual English/Hausa chat on 8 GB laptops with no internet.

test_prompts.prompt: A small business has revenue of 500,000 NGN, COGS of 200,000 NGN, and operating expenses of 150,000 NGN. Calculate the gross profit, gross margin percentage, and net profit. Then recommend two actions to improve profitability.
